snippet.title: Motor City Turf Wars | Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Motor City Turf Wars is a top-down Detroit crime sandbox that runs free in your browser. Build a crew, take over turf, drive the city at night and try to shake the cops.

Play free: https://burnerphonestudios.itch.io
Made by Burner Phone Studios.
